primary: 0.5 * mean(three Astra win rates) + 0.5 * mean(two bot2 win rates)

gates.specialist: versus D1: primary gain >= .01, paired seed-cluster 95% lower > 0, neither Astra nor bot2 declines > .05
gates.general: specialist gate plus old-pool versus H7 overall decline <= .03 and each opponent decline <= .10
gates.reliability: No unexplained errors, illegal actions, unexpected emergency fallback, or observed >2s local CLI decision; current-sequence legal output and exact artifact reproduction

statistics: 10000 paired bootstrap replicates of whole shared seed clusters; report board, sticky, weakest matchup and both seats. No claims of formal noninferiority.
errors: Every scheduled attempt remains charged. Harness errors count as zero score; do not drop anomalous pairs. An unexplained reliability error blocks promotion.
selection: Mechanism M1; response/search R1; learned evaluation L1. Compare each parent/child on same fresh development block. Reconfirm provisional winner on another new development block before freeze. No final-driven changes.
stop: At most three structural rounds plus one development retention block
Preserve 3200 full attempts for final/ZIP/client; reduce screening if necessary
limits: Fixed D1 deck, fixed existing opponents, no models or external services during decisions. Public views only. Full terminal continuations count as full games.
